quoted_identification: Coast Garibaldi Health is a Society registered in British Columbia.

attribution_page.governance_paraphrase: The page says the named society is subject to the Societies Act of BC and has a minister-appointed volunteer board, with nominees from Powell River, Sea to Sky and Sunshine Coast councils.

date_note: August 13, 2001 is the image archive capture, not a publication or adoption date. The filename CGHLogo2000.gif and copyright2000 do not establish the date of first use. Organization-page capture is August 3, 2001; its displayed last-modified date is June 26, 2001.
processing: Original downloaded GIF copied byte-for-byte to the deliverable. Preview PNG was generated only for visual inspection, not submitted as a new artwork file. No crop, cleanup, resampling, recolouring, tracing or reconstruction.
visual_verification: Original 200×64 artwork viewed at native size: teal circular mountain/landscape/water emblem, stacked italic serif Coast/Garibaldi/Health wordmark, white background. Attribution page links the exact image. All source pixels retained.
identity_boundary: Attribute this2001 image to the Community Health Services Society. No evidence establishes use by the earlier Coast Garibaldi Regional Health Board.
